hero.title: Build Smarter, Not Harder.
hero.subtitle: The ultimate OS for construction projects in emerging markets. Manage your budget, team, and timeline all in one place—from anywhere in the world.

operations.title: Streamline Your Operations
operations.description: DomusBuilder offers a comprehensive suite of tools designed to simplify project management.

items.name: Financial Control
items.description: Track expenses, manage budgets, and make data-driven decisions with our intuitive financial tools.

items.name: Team Collaboration
items.description: Keep your entire team in sync with real-time updates, task assignments, and centralized communication.

items.name: Timeline Management
items.description: Visualize your project's progress, set milestones, and ensure timely completion with our Gantt charts.

builderTypes.title: Built for Every Builder
builderTypes.description: Whether you're constructing a new home, renovating an existing one, or specializing in a specific trade, DomusBuilder is tailored to your needs.

types.title: Home Builders
types.description: Manage new construction projects from the ground up with tools for budgeting, scheduling, and client communication.

features.name: Blueprint Analysis
features.description: AI-powered analysis of your architectural plans to identify potential issues and optimize material usage.

features.name: Subcontractor Management
features.description: Assign tasks, track progress, and manage payments for all your subcontractors in one place.

features.name: Client Portal
features.description: Provide your clients with a dedicated portal to view progress, approve changes, and communicate with your team.

types.title: Renovation Experts
types.description: Transform existing spaces with precision. Track budgets, manage suppliers, and document every step of the renovation process.

features.name: Before & After Showcase
features.description: Easily create stunning visual comparisons to showcase your work to potential clients.

features.name: Material & Finish Selection
features.description: Collaborate with clients on material and finish choices, with a visual library and budget impact analysis.

features.name: Change Order Management
features.description: Streamline the change order process with digital approvals, transparent pricing, and schedule adjustments.

types.title: Specialty Contractors
types.description: Focus on your craft. Get clear instructions, submit progress updates, and manage your payments efficiently.

features.name: Task-Specific Work Orders
features.description: Receive detailed work orders with all necessary information, including plans, materials, and deadlines.

features.name: Mobile Field Updates
features.description: Submit progress photos, daily logs, and completion reports directly from the job site using your phone.

features.name: Invoice & Payment Tracking
features.description: Generate and submit invoices with ease, and track payment status in real-time.
